## Hypothesis
- What are we trying to learn or prove during this session?

## Guardrails
- Non-negotiables (architecture, security, performance constraints).
- Boundaries for scope, time, or tooling.

## Inputs
- Links to designs, docs, data sets, or previous attempts.

## Exit Criteria
- Definition of done for the spike (prototype, doc, checklist, etc.).

## Follow-ups
- Capture questions for reviewers, next steps, or decisions that need humans.
